title: 第25章 粉墨登场孟尘的目的第26章 神血白磷全部斩杀
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: “想不到，此处还藏有一处据点。”
战舟上，孟尘眸光俯视，只是看了那一面湖面，便收回了目光。
他也没想到，战舟刚路过此地，内心便察觉到一丝杀机，这才散出神念感应去查探。
孟尘自问，不是弑杀之人。
但在自己眼皮下商量要杀自己，他只能说这七个倒霉蛋出现的时间和地点，比较幸运吧。
秋岚山脉。
壮丽巍峨，一道道连绵山脉高耸入云，山腰之上白雪皑皑，下方则是无尽苍茫翠绿，远望此地，恍若置身世外圣境。
大虞狩猎选择此地，将其化为秘境，绝非是因为天然景色，而是这山脉深处，潜藏着各种妖兽与机缘造化。
对于参加的各大势力，这些历练与机缘，倒是其次。
最重要的是。
若能在此展现自己，显露非凡，定会被某个大人物看中，到时不仅可以名动天下，更是可以得到想象不到的地位与好处。
即便是孟尘这个皇子，此番参加狩猎，都被不少人关注着，想要看他能有怎样的表现。
皇子都如此，更何况是其他人呢。
当然，孟尘来此，并不是要给众人表现什么，除了身为皇子要参加外，他还有另一个目的。
那就是这秋岚山脉之中，藏着一桩造化。
其深处，蕴有一种万年天寒灵液，此物可蕴养血仙种，他自然要得到。
众人刚一临近，狩猎便开始了。
不少人在长辈的叮嘱下，露出自信目光，直接纵跃而下，朝着山脉深入而去。
京城中的一些权贵子弟，则身边跟随着诸多强者。
甚至，有的王权二代，直接带着一批侍卫进发。
他们一个个，都是老子的心头宝，倒不是他们主动想来，而是被逼着来到这种险地，不多准备一些安全措施，真怕没有命活着回来啊。
“嘶，好冷！”
有第一次前来的人，刚一离开战船范围，便感觉寒冷刺骨。
这里的环境，比他们想象的还要恶劣，若非他们都修炼到一定境界，怕是不出几个时辰，便会活活冻死在这里了。
“哼，丢人现眼，回家吃奶去吧！”
有人冷哼，这是一个神秘人，脸上戴着黑色面具，虽看不清真实身份，但显然是来自一方宗门的天骄。
话音刚落，他身影便消失在了丛林之中。
他们这些宗门势力，想要参加这秋岚狩猎，不仅要实力足够，还需要一些气运才有资格前来。
而这怕冷的京城二代，身边跟着一群人保护不说，自身还弱的如废物。
这种草包，竟然都可随意来此，怎能让他瞧得起。
“你敢羞辱本少！”
content_en:
"Unexpectedly, there is a stronghold hidden here."
On the war boat, Meng Chen looked down, only looked at that side of the lake, and then looked away.
He also didn't expect that as soon as Zhan Zhou passed by this place, he felt a hint of murderous intent in his heart, and then he sent out his spiritual sense to investigate.
Meng Chen asked himself, he was not the murderer.
But when they discussed killing him under his own nose, he could only say that the time and place where these seven unlucky men appeared were relatively lucky.
Qiulan Mountains.
It is majestic and majestic, with continuous mountains reaching into the clouds. The mountainside is covered with snow, and below is endless green green. Looking at this place from a distance, it feels like you are in a holy place outside the world.
Dayu Hunting chose this place to turn it into a secret realm, not because of the natural scenery, but because of the various monsters and opportunities lurking deep in the mountains.
For the major forces participating, these experiences and opportunities are secondary.
The most important thing is.
If you can show yourself here and be extraordinary, you will definitely be noticed by a big shot. Not only will you become famous all over the world, but you will also get unimaginable status and benefits.
Even for the prince Meng Chen, many people were paying attention to his participation in the hunt this time, wanting to see how he would perform.
This is true for all princes, let alone others.
Of course, Meng Chen didn't come here to show anything to everyone. In addition to participating as a prince, he also had another purpose.
That is, there is a good fortune hidden in the Qiulan Mountains.
In its depths, there is a kind of spiritual liquid that has been cold for thousands of years. This thing can nourish blood fairy seeds, so he naturally wants to get it.
As soon as the crowd approached, the hunting began.
Under the instructions of their elders, many people looked confidently and jumped directly down, heading deeper into the mountains.
Some of the powerful disciples in the capital were followed by many strong men.
Some of the second generation kings even marched directly with a group of guards.
Each one of them is my favorite. It's not that they wanted to come, but they were forced to come to such a dangerous place. If they don't prepare some safety measures, they are really afraid that they will not come back alive.
"Hiss, it's so cold!"
Some people who came here for the first time felt bitingly cold as soon as they left the range of the warship.
The environment here is worse than they imagined. If they hadn't cultivated to a certain level, they would freeze to death here within a few hours.
"Humph, it's embarrassing, go home and feed yourself!"
Someone snorted, this is a mysterious man with a black mask on his face. Although his true identity cannot be seen clearly, he is obviously a genius from a sect.
As soon as he finished speaking, his figure disappeared into the jungle.
If they, the sect forces, want to participate in the Qiulan Hunting, they must not only be strong enough, but also need some luck to be qualified to come.
And this second-generation Beijing man who was afraid of the cold was surrounded by a group of people to protect him, but he himself was as weak as trash.
This kind of idiot can come here at will, how can he think so highly of him?
"How dare you humiliate me!"
